limitations: Same-source transformed controls, not human duplicate truth
Distinct source pairs are unreviewed, not confirmed negatives
No cropping, panel reuse, rotation or text-overlay controls
Similar hashes only flag; exact bytes/pixels alone skip
Threshold sweep does not automatically select a threshold
manifest_scope: Only source figures, licences, dimensions and hashes used; old detector scores in this manifest remain void.
threshold_decision: Keep 4 bits. Controlled perturbations do not justify fitting a new production threshold without reviewed natural duplicate/negative pairs.

close_pair_visual_inspection.reviewer: assistant visual inspection, not independent human review
close_pair_visual_inspection.observation: Three similarly arranged colored bar charts; Fig6 axes report adhesion rate, Fig7 invasion rate. Different axes and bar values. Distinct figures with similar layout.

reproducibility.command: PYTHONPATH=$PWD CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 tools/run_capped.sh 4G python tools/evaluate_plaque_duplicate_threshold.py --manifest features/data/424_detector_transfer_2026-09-19.json --images /path/to/restored/figures --output /path/to/result.json
